title: Fidel Castro and the revolution
goal: Follow the rebels from the Moncada attack to the fall of Batista, and say what had already happened with the pluperfect.

items: I can say what happened at the Moncada barracks in 1953.
I can describe how the Granma reached Cuba in 1956.
I can say who Che Guevara was.
I can say what the rebels had already done when Batista fled.
I can say what had already happened before another past event with the pluperfect.
